title: cytisus scoparius subsp. cantabricus
intro: Cytisus scoparius subsp. cantabricus, commonly known as Cantabrian broom, is a subspecies of the broom plant, a type of flowering evergreen shrub native to northern Spain. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cantabrian broom include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its medicinal effects. The bioactive constituents of Cytisus scoparius subsp. cantabricus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
